reviews.author: Christine L
reviews.text: Blake is the Best! She listened to what I wanted (as always) and did exactly what I wanted.

reviews.author: Carey U
reviews.text: Clean. Cute. Cozy. Always a great conversation while getting my beautiful lashes!

reviews.author: Florence G
reviews.text: Easy location and easy access, and plenty of parking. Blake is an absolute sweetheart. My lashes look great after every appointment and I get what I asked for.

reviews.author: Carey U
reviews.text: Very convenient location. The place feels new even though the building has been around for a long time Every appointment is great! Blake is personable and fun! She will carry on a conversation or let you rest. I love my ME time laying on her cozy table!

reviews.author: Christine Lopour
reviews.text: Blake is the Best! She listened to how I wanted my eyelashes, they are exactly what I wanted. She spent time with me deciding just the right tint for my graying eyebrows. I’ll definitely be returning and recommending her.

reviews.author: Carey U
reviews.text: I absolutely love my lashes! Natural and beautiful!

reviews.author: Robyn Kearl
reviews.text: Blake is so amazing and I look forward to going and seeing her for my appointments! I am constantly getting compliments on my lashes! She does a phenomenal job!

reviews.author: TarahAnn Hyatt
reviews.text: I’ve been going to Blake for years now and she is amazing!! She is super sweet and professional! Her studio is always so clean and my lashes always look and feel great. I have never had a problem with my lashes from Blake, I would recommend her to anyone!

reviews.author: sarah moon
reviews.text: I’ve been going to Blake for over a year now and the compliments I’ve gotten on my lashes are endless. I always look forward to my appointments and can’t speak high enough about Blake’s talent. She’s simply amazing and a sweetheart

reviews.author: Morgan Valentine
reviews.text: This is 2 weeks after my lash lift and tint and they are still beautiful, soft, and lifted! Usually at this point they start to get brittle and look like broken spider legs, but not with Blake's work! Can't wait to go back!
